prose: This month's deconstruction of Disney-Marvel mind control is going to be a doozy. The gang has been just itching to get back together to analyze the new 6 episode Disney+ series, Moon Knight, and in this video we'll tackle the first episode. The returning overarching theme is Disassociative Identity Disorder and the MK Ultra of it all, but we'll also do our best to demonstrate the distortion of public perception regarding ancient Egyptian culture.
The Marvelous Demystifiers are: Chance Garton, Gabriel (Slick Dissident), Gordan Hamil.
